name: Where Two Or More Are Gathered
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the power and presence of Christ when believers gather in unity and agreement. Jesus teaches that where two or three are gathered in His name, He is present among them, affirming the spiritual significance of communal worship and prayer (Matthew 18:20). This unity is essential, as Amos 3:3 highlights that two cannot walk together unless they are agreed, and Matthew 18:19 promises that when believers agree in prayer, their requests are heard by the Father. The context of Matthew 18 also underscores the importance of forgiveness and humility within the community, illustrating how Christ-centered fellowship fosters both spiritual authority and relational restoration.
